head: YouTube Music Gemini button: Ask Music now on almost every screen
dek: YouTube Music on Android and iPhone now has a Gemini icon in the top-right corner that opens Ask Music, the AI helper that builds mixes and playlists. It shows on Home, Library, Now Playing, albums and playlists, and needs YouTube Premium or YouTube Music Premium.
details: Tapping the icon opens Ask Music as a full-screen sheet, where you type or speak a request: make a mix, find artists or podcasts, build a playlist, change your queue or ask about your listening history. Ask Music launched in 2024 and until now sat in a card in the Home feed. The new button is a server-side change that started rolling out in the last few days, according to 9to5Google, and YouTube had previewed it in September.
where: Android and iPhone, YouTube Premium and Music Premium subscribers, rolling out now
means: If you pay for Premium, you can ask for a playlist or a mix from whatever screen you're on, without going back to Home first. Without Premium, Ask Music isn't available.
todo: Update YouTube Music and look for the Gemini spark at the top right. If it isn't there yet, it arrives through a server-side rollout, so there's nothing to install.
